title: Feature-Scaling and Stability-Testing Pipeline for Clustering Small Orchard IoT Datasets
description: Analysis code and reproducibility package for the study "A feature-scaling and stability-testing pipeline for clustering small orchard IoT datasets" (submitted to PeerJ Computer Science). Couples hourly IoT microclimate with periodic field phenology and clusters a small orchard dataset with explicit feature scaling and bootstrap/permutation stability testing.
